pattern: SELECT MAX\(.*\) as .* FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND (?=SELECT .*\(FROM country WHERE Continent = '.*'\))
correction: Replace with: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia' AND population > (SELECT min(population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Africa')

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly use aggregate functions (MAX, MIN, etc.) without filtering the results by the required continent.
